decisions.reason: The shared-footer effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE establishing that the footer is shared across webpages.
The shared website header, footer, and dark theme apply to webpages; the source explicitly treats the dashboard shell as a separate build requiring only shell-container styling guidance.
Shared website chrome and theme do not change the independently defined breakpoint guidance, which is already represented by a separate same-message Event.
The source preserves the landing page's existing dark theme as the reference for other webpages and does not change the landing-page visual system itself.
The cross-page theme and shared-chrome decision does not alter the section's position, presentation, or steps.
Preserving the landing page's dark theme and sharing website chrome does not change its responsive-layout behavior.
The shared visual-foundation decision does not change which copy is included on the landing page.
The cross-page theme and chrome decision does not change the sign-up CTA's action or control.
The source Event changes the shared visual foundation, not the established HTML, Tailwind CSS, or Astro implementation choices.
